title: One sort, less memory
data: t: 1,000,000 rows of i and a value v, generated by DuckDB, sorted into a table each time.

cases.label: A memory limit of 4GB
cases.detail: SET memory_limit = '4GB'; CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE sorted AS SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY v

cases.label: A memory limit of 16MB
cases.detail: SET memory_limit = '16MB'; CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE sorted AS SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY v
